question: 45% of the students are girls. If the number of girls is 540, find the total number of students.
explanation: Here, 45% of the students equals 540. | \[\Rightarrow 45\%\rightarrow540\] | To determine the value of 1%, divide 540 by 45. | \[\Rightarrow 1\%=\frac{540}{45}=12\] | Now multiply the value of 1% by 100 to get the whole. | \[\Rightarrow 100\%=12\times100=1200\] | Therefore the total students is 1200. | \[\Rightarrow \text{Total students}=1200\]

question: If 25% of the income equals Rs. 6250, find 50% of the same income.

question: A quantity is divided in the ratio 1:2. Find the percentage corresponding to the first part.
